% Pattern: number/restated. A copy of a numbered proposition in a
% \newtheorem* environment restates it, and prints no number. Seen in the
% gold pilot (set X).
% want proposition-1 statement/proposition 1
% want proposition--1 statement/proposition -
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\newtheorem*{proposition*}{Proposition}
\begin{document}
\begin{proposition} Every finite topological space is compact, and every closed subset of it is compact. \end{proposition}
\begin{proposition*} Every finite topological space is compact, and every closed subset of it is compact. \end{proposition*}
\end{document}
